roadmap.title: Dutch's Island
roadmap.description: Finish the opening mission on Dutch's island.

roadmap.title: Hope County open world
roadmap.description: Roam Hope County and complete outposts, side missions, hunting and fishing, shops, perks and combat counters at your own pace.

roadmap.title: Region stories
roadmap.description: Work through John's, Jacob's and Faith's regions and their story missions and side missions, and raise Resistance.

roadmap.title: Finale
roadmap.description: Finish the campaign with the final story mission.

roadmap.title: New Game+
roadmap.description: After finishing the base game, play New Game+ on Infamous difficulty.

roadmap.title: Arcade and co-op
roadmap.description: Play Arcade levels, featured maps and multiplayer wins, ideally with friends.

roadmap.title: Hours of Darkness
roadmap.description: Play the Vietnam DLC for the stealth, airstrike and prisoner achievements, then finish it in all three modes.

roadmap.title: Lost on Mars
roadmap.description: Play the Mars DLC, finish every optional goal, and only then accept the final mission.

roadmap.title: Dead Living Zombies
roadmap.description: Play the zombie pitches, then the long tractor grind and gold medals.

achievements.description: Complete the game intro by liberating Dutch’s island (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the opening mission by liberating Dutch's island in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Follow the story on @loc{Dutch's Island} until you activate the radio tower.

achievements.description: Be deemed the Sin of Wrath (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Story mission The Confession in John's region.
achievements.summary: Be named the Sin of Wrath during the solo campaign.

steps.text: Play the story mission "The Confession" in @loc{John's region}.

achievements.description: Ensure a baby's safe passage into this world (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Side mission opens after John's region is liberated.
achievements.summary: Finish the "Special Delivery" side mission so a baby is born safely, in the solo campaign.

guide.context: The mission only appears after John's region is liberated. Side missions never expire, so you can do it any time after that.

steps.text: Liberate @loc{John's region} in the south of the map, including defeating John.
Wait for @npc{Kim Rye} to message you, then follow the new map marker to start "Special Delivery".
Drive from the start point to the end point, dealing with the obstacles on the way.

achievements.description: Sucessfully complete the First Trial (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Complete the First Trial in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Raise the Resistance level in @loc{Jacob's region} to level 2.
Let the story capture you, then finish the story mission "The World Is Weak".

achievements.description: Discover the Bliss (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Discover the Bliss during the solo campaign.

steps.text: Raise the Resistance level in @loc{Faith's region} to level 2.
Finish the story mission "The Bliss".

achievements.description: Get to the End (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Reach the end of the solo campaign by finishing the final story mission.

steps.text: When the last story mission "Where It All Began" asks for a choice, pick @mechanic{Resist}.
Finish the mission.

achievements.description: Save Deputy Hudson (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Save Deputy Hudson in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Complete the story mission "The Quality of Mercy" in @loc{John's region} and save @npc{Deputy Hudson}.

achievements.description: Save the Marshal from the Bliss (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Save the Marshal from the Bliss in the solo campaign.

steps.text: During the story mission "Ignorance of Bliss" in @loc{Faith's region}, do not let the @npc{Marshal} walk through the gate.

achievements.description: Save Sheriff Whitehorse (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Save Sheriff Whitehorse in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Complete the story mission "Walk the Path" in @loc{Faith's region} and save @npc{Sheriff Whitehorse}.

achievements.description: Save Deputy Pratt (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Save Deputy Pratt in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Complete the story mission "Casualties of War" in @loc{Jacob's region} and save @npc{Deputy Pratt}.

achievements.description: Put aside skepticism and help Larry (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Side mission chain in John's region.
achievements.summary: Finish all four of Larry's side missions in the solo campaign.

guide.context: The missions open about halfway through liberating John's region and never expire. The reward is a weapon, the Magnopulser, plus Larry's boots.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Parker Laboratories}, west of the main settlement of the Fall's End area, and turn off the 3 force field generators to free @npc{Larry}.
Finish "Free Larry".
Finish "The Hero's Journey", then "Close Encounters".
Finish "Out of this World" to get the achievement.

achievements.description: Who are these people? Speak to 50 citizens of Hope County (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Counter that grows during normal play.
achievements.summary: Hear 50 different conversations with citizens of Hope County in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Talk to every person you meet: rescued civilians, people in liberated outposts and settlements, and shop owners.
Keep going until the counter reaches 50 different dialogues; repeated dialogues do not count.

achievements.description: Complete all Hunting & Fishing Challenges (Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Late open-world completion; fish side overlaps the rods achievement.
achievements.summary: Complete every Hunting and Fishing challenge in the Challenges menu.

guide.context: Challenge progress shows in the Challenges menu. Do this late, when most of the map and its hunting spots are discovered. Explosives and fire ruin skins, so kill animals with a gun or bow.

steps.text: Buy the perks @mechanic{Harvest Master} (8 perk points), @mechanic{Journey Pack} (7) and @mechanic{Throwables Bag} (9).
Recruit @npc{Boomer} to mark animals, and buy the SA-50 rifle for one-shot kills.

Finish the 16 animal challenges. Deer, Pronghorns, Elks and Caribou come first, then Bison, Moose, Hares and Boars. Next are Skunk, Wolverines, Wolves and Cougars. The last four are Black Bears, Grizzly Bears, Turkeys and Eagles.
If an animal does not appear, use the @item{Ultimate Hunter} homeopathic to mark everything nearby, or wait a few minutes in the area.

Get the third fishing rod, then finish the 12 fish challenges. They are Kokanees, Arctic Graylings, Golden Trouts and Rock Bass. They also include Smallmouths, Largemouths, Bull Trout and Lake Trout. The rest are Rainbow Trouts, Chinooks, Pallid Sturgeons and Paddlefish.
Switch bobbers to suit the fish you are catching.

achievements.description: Liberate 5 locations from the Project at Eden's Gate (Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Outposts are liberated naturally early on.
achievements.summary: Liberate 5 outposts held by the Project at Eden's Gate in the campaign.

steps.text: Kill every enemy in an outpost's area, including any reinforcements if the alarm goes off.
Repeat until 5 outposts are liberated.

achievements.description: Follow the clues to the end of 3 treasure hunts (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Treasure hunts available from early on.
achievements.summary: Solve 3 treasure hunts (prepper stashes) by following their clues to the loot, in the solo campaign.

guide.context: Treasures show as a green diamond on the map. Civilians with a green diamond over their head give stash information. Reaching the spot is not enough: each stash is hidden and needs a bit of thinking to enter.

steps.text: Rescue and talk to civilians to learn stash locations.
Reach the marked spot and work out how to get inside or find the hidden stash.
Finish 3 treasure hunts. Keep a few unused for the co-op quest achievement.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Side Missions in Hope County (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish any 3 side missions in Hope County during the solo campaign.

steps.text: Start side missions from their map icons in any region and finish 3.

achievements.displayName: The Greatest SOB That Ever Lived
achievements.description: Laugh in danger's face by executing a Clutch Nixon stunt in each region (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Time trials spread over the regions.
achievements.summary: Complete a Clutch Nixon challenge in each of the three regions during the solo campaign.

guide.context: Only the solo campaign counts. Clutch Nixon challenges done in co-op may not register.

steps.text: Find the Clutch Nixon icon in @loc{John's region} and finish a challenge.
Do the same in @loc{Jacob's region} and @loc{Faith's region}.

achievements.description: Grab 1 of each collectible item. You never know when it will come in handy (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: One of each of six collectible types.
achievements.summary: Grab 1 of each of the six collectible types in the solo campaign.

guide.context: You only need one item from each of the six types. Taking the related quest lets you buy a map showing every item of that type.

collectibles.name: Baseball Card
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 9 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 baseball card.

collectibles.name: Comic Book
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 12 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 comic book.

collectibles.name: Cheeseburger Bobblehead
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 10 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 bobblehead.

collectibles.name: Vietnam Lighter
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 12 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 lighter.

collectibles.name: Vinyl Crate
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 10 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 vinyl crate.

collectibles.name: Whiskey Cask
collectibles.location: Anywhere in Hope County; 15 exist.
collectibles.method: Pick up any 1 whiskey cask.

achievements.description: Fly Nick's plane. Hopefully you're not afraid of heights (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Story mission Wingman in John's region.
achievements.summary: Fly Nick's plane in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Complete the story mission "Wingman" in @loc{John's region}.

achievements.description: Discover the joys of destroying cult property in every region (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Most targets are in story missions.
achievements.summary: Destroy cult property in every region, including Dutch's island, in the solo campaign.

guide.context: Most targets appear in story missions, and a plane or helicopter makes the rest easy.

steps.text: Destroy a @item{Silo} in @loc{John's region}.
Destroy a @item{Wolf Beacon} in @loc{Jacob's region}.
Destroy a @item{Shrine} in @loc{Faith's region}.
Destroy a @item{Shrine} on @loc{Dutch's Island}.

achievements.description: Destroy a cult water treatment pump and make them thirst for revenge (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.sortReason: Faith region mission; best done before The Lesson.
achievements.summary: Finish the "Clean Water Act" mission by destroying the cult water treatment pumps in the solo campaign.

guide.context: If you have not received the mission before the Faith boss fight, go to the water treatment plant yourself. @npc{Virgil} dies in "The Lesson", so do not leave this too late.

steps.text: Go to the water treatment plant in @loc{Faith's region}, clear the enemies and start "Clean Water Act".
Drain the matching water tank, crawl through its pipes to a closed building, and find the pump inside.
Blow up each pump; the last one completes the mission.

achievements.description: Bait Peaches into going back home (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Bait Peaches into going back home in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Finish the story mission "Here Kitty, Kitty" in @loc{Faith's region}.

achievements.description: Trigger the wrath of a Herald (Solo Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Trigger the wrath of a Herald by reaching Resistance level 4 in any region in the solo campaign.

guide.context: Maxing a region's Resistance starts that region's boss sequence by itself, even in the middle of another activity. Killing the boss removes many enemies there, so do kill-based achievements first.

steps.text: Earn Resistance points in one region with story and side missions, outpost liberations, rescues, destroyed cult trucks and blockades, and killed VIPs.
Keep going until the region reaches its top level.

achievements.description: Reach level 20 in the Arcade (Arcade only).
achievements.sortReason: Comes along with other Arcade achievements.
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in Arcade.

guide.context: Any Arcade play earns XP; regular multiplayer gives more than solo or co-op maps.

steps.text: Play Arcade matches, preferably standard multiplayer on maps made by Ubisoft, until you reach level 20.

achievements.description: Play the 'Arcade Hero' mode 5 times (Arcade only).
achievements.summary: Play the Arcade Hero mode 5 times.

guide.context: Finish each map to be safe, and load another one if a map is broken or too long.

steps.text: Open Arcade Hero, which uses maps made by players.
Finish 5 maps; the game picks the map for you.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies in Arcade Multiplayer maps (Arcade only).
achievements.summary: Get 100 kills against other players on Arcade multiplayer maps.

steps.text: Join a closed lobby with a friend and choose the map "Shovel Dodgers".
Replay that map until you reach 100 kills.

achievements.description: Successfully complete 10 featured Arcade maps in Solo or Co-op (Arcade only).
achievements.summary: Beat 10 featured Arcade maps in the solo or co-op playlist.

guide.context: Using the Replay button does not count. Go back to the menu and pick maps again instead.

steps.text: Open Arcade, choose Play Solo & Co-Op, switch the category to Featured, and press Search.
Choose Assault or Bounty Hunt maps, which are usually the easiest.
Finish 10 different featured maps.

achievements.description: Win 10 featured maps in Multiplayer (Arcade only).
achievements.summary: Win 10 featured Arcade maps in multiplayer.

guide.context: After each match the game picks the next map from player votes, so Ubisoft maps may take a while to come up.

steps.text: Play standard multiplayer and vote for Ubisoft (featured) maps; the NEON map is popular.
Leave a match that starts on a non-Ubisoft map until you land on a featured one.
Win 10 matches on featured maps. A private match with 6 players is the fastest.

achievements.description: Truly bond with Hurk by destroying 15 vehicles together (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Blow up 15 vehicles while Hurk is your active companion in the campaign.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Jacob's region} mission that lets you recruit @npc{Hurk}, then take him as your companion.
Go to a garage and spawn vehicles for him to destroy.
Repeat until 15 vehicles are destroyed.

achievements.description: Acquire all 4 Fishing Rods (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Acquire all 4 fishing rods in the campaign.

guide.context: The Basic and Natural rods are quick. Get the Wonderboy rod before trying Old Betsy, because record fish need the third rod.

collectibles.name: Basic Fishing Rod
collectibles.location: Any shop, or free near any fishing spot.
collectibles.method: Buy it for $300, or pick it up at a fishing spot.

collectibles.name: Natural Fishing Rod
collectibles.location: Any shop.
collectibles.method: Buy it for $800.

collectibles.name: Wonderboy Fishing Rod
collectibles.location: @npc{Skylar} at @loc{Dylan's Master Bait Shop}, in the @loc{Whitetail Mountain} area.
collectibles.method: Finish all of Skylar's side missions. The last one is catching @enemy{The Admiral}. On PC, keep moving the mouse smoothly to one side to hold the rod steady.

collectibles.name: Old Betsy Fishing Rod
collectibles.location: Record boards: @loc{Spread Eagle Bar} in Fall's End (back left), @loc{Hope County Jail} (door left of the shop entrance), @loc{Wolf's Den} (behind the shop counter).
collectibles.method: Land fish that outweigh the board record, only at spots marked Hard. Records on the left of each board: Rainbow Trout 28 lbs, Lake Trout 37 lbs, Golden Trout 4 lbs, Bull Trout 21 lbs. Regional records follow. In Holland Valley the targets are Paddlefish 112 lbs and Pallid Sturgeon 55 lbs. Henbane River wants Largemouth Bass 8 lbs, Smallmouth Bass 6 lbs and Rock Bass 3 lbs. Whitetail Mountains wants Arctic Grayling 3 lbs, Kokanee Salmon 6 lbs and Chinook Salmon 27 lbs.

achievements.description: Fully customize your weapon (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for one weapon in the campaign.

guide.context: Paint jobs do not count, so skip them.

steps.text: Pick a weapon with few upgrades, such as the bow, a pistol or a revolver.
Buy all its upgrades at a gun store.

achievements.description: Perform a Headshot kill with any bow or rifle on an enemy cultist more than 150m away (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Shoot a cultist in the head with a bow or rifle from over 150 m away in the campaign.

steps.text: Equip a sniper rifle such as the SA-50 with the best scope.
Stand about 160 m from the Sacred Skies Youth Camp in @loc{Faith's region} and mark the guard on the roof with binoculars.
Aim and shoot the head. If it misses, try the other guards. If you already liberated the camp, reset outposts first.

achievements.description: Craft 25 recipes (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Craft 25 recipes in the campaign.

steps.text: Craft the simplest recipes, such as @item{Liquor} and @item{Oregano}, which need one material each.
Craft molotovs or buffs like @item{The Fast}, @item{The Furious}, @item{Ultimate Hunter} and @item{Ultimate Survivor} until you reach 25.

achievements.description: Purchase $1000 in clothing (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Spend $1000 on clothing in the campaign.

steps.text: Buy clothes at a gun store until you have spent $1000 in total.

achievements.description: Spend $50000 in Vehicle Shops (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Spend $50000 in vehicle shops in the campaign.

steps.text: Buy vehicles until you have spent $50000 in total.

achievements.description: Buy 3 vehicles to populate your garage (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Buy 3 vehicles for your garage in the campaign.

guide.context: Boats, planes and helicopters count.

steps.text: Buy any 3 vehicles.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 planes while driving any aerial vehicle (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 planes while driving an aerial vehicle in the campaign.

guide.context: Helicopters as targets do not count.

steps.text: Fly Nick's plane or your own aerial vehicle to @loc{Nick Rye's} and destroy the plane parked on the ground.
Fast travel away and back, then repeat until 10 planes are destroyed.

achievements.description: Run over and kill 20 enemies (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Run over and kill 20 enemies in the campaign.

steps.text: Drive any vehicle into enemies until 20 are dead.

achievements.description: Using a tractor, obliterate 5 enemies (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with a tractor in the campaign.

guide.context: Use a tractor with a grinder fitted to the front.

steps.text: Find a tractor with the grinder on its front, such as the one in @npc{Guy Marvel}'s final side mission.
Drive it into enemies until 5 are dead.

achievements.description: Drop a bomb from a plane and destroy or disable 4 vehicles at once (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Take out 4 vehicles with a single bomb dropped from a plane in the campaign.

guide.context: If vehicles disappear when you spawn another, have companions drive to your parked plane instead, because their vehicles do not despawn.

steps.text: Get a plane with bombs: Nick's plane or the Pack Hunter.
Land it by a garage, spawn 4 vehicles right next to the plane, and get in.
Drop a bomb on them.

achievements.description: Using rocks or cans, distract 15 enemies (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Distract 15 different enemies with thrown rocks or cans in the campaign.

guide.context: Each enemy must walk toward the thrown object. Enemies that notice you afterward may not register.

steps.text: Throw a rock or can near an enemy and wait for them to walk toward it.
Do this to 15 different enemies; reset outposts to get more.

achievements.description: While driving or leaning out of a vehicle, kill 25 enemies (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Get 25 kills from a vehicle, either at the wheel or leaning out of it, in the campaign.

steps.text: Drive a vehicle with a mounted gun, for example the truck you get from the "Widowmaker" mission.
Drive through enemy areas and shoot until 25 are dead.

achievements.description: Sell 20 fish for cash (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Sell 20 fish in the campaign.

steps.text: Sell the fish you catch at any store until you have sold 20.

achievements.description: Tenderize a bull with your bare hands. To death (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Beat a bull to death with your bare hands in the campaign.

guide.context: Brass Knuckles cannot be removed once bought. If you own them, kick the bull instead.

steps.text: Craft @item{The Furious} homeopathic.
Go east of Fall's End in @loc{John's region} and punch a bull until it dies.

achievements.description: Kill a bison using only melee weapons (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill a bison with melee weapons alone in the campaign.

steps.text: Craft @item{The Furious} homeopathic.
Find a bison along the roads in @loc{Faith's region} and kill it with a melee weapon.

achievements.description: Play 3 quests with a friend (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Play 3 quests with a friend in the campaign.

guide.context: Only the host earns campaign achievements, so swap host if you both need it.

steps.text: Invite a friend into your campaign.
Finish 3 quests together; treasure hunts count and are fastest.

achievements.description: Use a wingsuit to travel more than 5000m (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Travel more than 5000 m with a wingsuit in the campaign.

guide.context: The distance adds up over many flights.

steps.text: Buy the @mechanic{Wingsuit} perk (4 perk points); the @mechanic{Airdrop} perk (10 points) also helps.
Jump from high places such as Joseph's statue in the middle of the map, or from a helicopter, and glide.

achievements.description: Perform 25 close combat Takedown Kills (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Get 25 close combat takedown kills in the campaign.

guide.context: Outposts can be reset from the pause menu after you liberate them all.

steps.text: Kill enemies from behind or unseen from the front or side with takedowns until you reach 25.
If outposts are all liberated, use the @mechanic{Outpost Master} option in the pause menu.

achievements.description: Sabotage 5 vehicles in a way that kills an enemy (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Sabotage 5 vehicles so each one kills an enemy in the campaign.

guide.context: Lowering the difficulty makes this easier.

steps.text: Buy the @mechanic{Sabotage} perk (7 perk points).
Sabotage cultist cars you stop on the road. Or fight in the Sacred Skies Youth Camp area of @loc{Faith's region} and sabotage the reinforcement trucks.

achievements.description: Purchase half of all perks available (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Buy half of all perks in the campaign.

guide.context: There are 50 perks, so you need 25.

steps.text: Earn perk points from treasure hunts, which give 3 each, and from challenges, which give 1 to 4 each.
Buy 25 perks.

achievements.description: Perform 25 stealth kills while you have the 4 survival instinct tokens.
achievements.summary: Perform 25 stealth kills while you hold all 4 survival instinct tokens in Hours of Darkness.

guide.context: Tokens work like a kill streak. You need 4 undetected kills in a row to fill them, so the minimum is 29 kills. The streak resets when you die, are detected or reload a save. Do this in one playthrough.

steps.text: Make 4 undetected kills back to back to fill all four tokens.
Keep making stealth kills with silenced weapons or takedowns until 25 count.

achievements.description: Complete the game in Action Movie Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete Hours of Darkness in Action Movie Mode.

guide.context: Action Movie Mode becomes available after your first completion.

steps.text: Start Action Movie Mode.
Reach the extraction point and blow up the anti-aircraft guns with remote explosives placed near them; airstrikes cannot do this.
Collect the documents and survive until the end.

achievements.description: Complete the game.
achievements.summary: Complete Hours of Darkness.

steps.text: After collecting your gear, go to the evacuation point.
Destroy two anti-aircraft guns, collect the documents, and defend the landing zone until the helicopter ride and credits.

achievements.description: Complete the game in Survivor Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete Hours of Darkness in Survivor Mode.

guide.context: Survivor Mode becomes available after your first completion.

steps.text: Run to the main objective, skipping side missions.
Hold the landing zone with unlimited airstrikes and found weapons.

achievements.description: Free the 3 US prisoner of war.
achievements.summary: Rescue all 3 captured US soldiers in Hours of Darkness.

guide.context: Free all three before you leave in the helicopter at the end. If a prisoner is executed, start a new run, because they do not respawn.

steps.text: Free the camp holding Joker and Moses, then free both prisoners.
Enter the camp holding Yokel and kill the NVA commander quickly before he kills Yokel.
If Yokel dies, reload the last checkpoint and retry.

achievements.description: Kill a total of 25 enemies with airstrikes.
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with airstrikes in Hours of Darkness.

guide.context: Do this in one playthrough. The tracker may stall; dying can fix it.

steps.text: Call airstrikes on camps along the route, then keep using them during the last landing zone defense.

achievements.description: Get back your gear at the helicopter crash site.
achievements.summary: Recover your equipment next to the crashed helicopter in Hours of Darkness.

steps.text: Pick up your gear next to the helicopter.

achievements.description: Perform 10 takedowns on Arachnids using the Power Glove.
achievements.summary: Perform 10 takedowns on Arachnids with the Power Glove in Lost on Mars.

guide.context: Takedowns do not work on armored crabs or on Queens.

steps.text: Pick up the Power Glove when you power the Solar System Observatory antenna.
Aim at a crab's red weak spot on its back, often by jumping over it with the jetpack.
Perform 10 takedowns.

achievements.description: Buy 12 weapons.
achievements.sortReason: Needs money late in the DLC.
achievements.summary: Buy 12 weapons in Lost on Mars.

guide.context: Weapons unlock for purchase as you power up antennas. Spare power cores sell for $1000 each.

steps.text: Power up antennas to unlock the 3D printer at each site.
Buy 12 weapons, for example from the $450 tier first.

achievements.description: Collect all of Larry's notes (Host Only).
achievements.summary: Collect all of Larry's notes in Lost on Mars as the host.

guide.context: Collect all 28 before you accept the final mission, because there is no free roam afterwards. The map does not mark them and nothing counts them for you. Wait until all antennas are powered, then fast travel between spots. Notes stay in the world after pickup, so write down which ones you have taken.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 1
collectibles.location: Roof of the Robot Repair Center, on a crate.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 2
collectibles.location: Top of a very tall metal tower close to the Bovine Research Center.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 3
collectibles.location: A single metallic box lying in the dirt.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 4
collectibles.location: On a box on a big metallic platform east of the Solar System Observatory, above ground.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 5
collectibles.location: On a box under a tall metallic tower.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 6
collectibles.location: On a box on the ark.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 7
collectibles.location: Crate at the top of a metal tower.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 8
collectibles.location: On a box next to a small metallic shrine-like structure.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 9
collectibles.location: Base of a wide metal platform, together with one of Hurk's body parts.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 10
collectibles.location: On a table inside the Robot Creation Center.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 11
collectibles.location: Crate at the summit of a tall metal tower.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 12
collectibles.location: Lone crate in the desert beside a round metal platform.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 13
collectibles.location: On top of a flying platform; the easiest route is a wingsuit glide from the Pits of Peril Antenna.
collectibles.method: Walk up to it and take it when the orange icon shows.

collectibles.name: Larry's Note 14

achievements.description: Complete the game (Host Only).
achievements.sortReason: Point of no return in the DLC.
achievements.summary: Complete Lost on Mars.

guide.context: After every antenna is cleared and you take the final mission from Anne, you cannot return to free roam.

steps.text: Finish all other Lost on Mars achievements first.
Accept the final mission from Anne and finish the game.

achievements.description: Hit 10 Arachnids with Crabmones.
achievements.summary: Hit 10 Arachnids with Crabmones in Lost on Mars.

guide.context: A hit makes other arachnids nearby ignore you and attack the target for a while.

steps.text: Pick up Crabmones, the green eggs in nests.
Throw them at arachnids until 10 have been hit; each should get a green aura.

achievements.displayName: DLC: Mars: The Queen is Dead!
achievements.description: Kill all the Queens (Host Only).
achievements.sortReason: All Queens before the final mission.
achievements.summary: Kill all the Queens in Lost on Mars as the host.

steps.text: Use Crabmones so nearby arachnids help you against a Queen.
Destroy nests to make the Queen surface when she hides underground.
Repeat for every Queen.

achievements.description: Reboot the Terminal on top of the Control Center Antenna.
achievements.summary: Restart the terminal at the top of the Control Center Antenna in Lost on Mars.

steps.text: Finish the main mission "Control Center Antenna" by rebooting the terminal on top.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Gougers or Hot Heads with the tractor in Fields of Terror.
achievements.summary: Flatten 10 Gouger or Hot Head zombies using a tractor on the Fields of Terror level.

steps.text: In @loc{Fields of Terror}, take the dirt road left of the start house to the tractor.
Run over 10 zombies.

achievements.description: Try to escape the bridge early in Burned Bridges.
achievements.summary: Leave the bridge too early in Burned Bridges by leaping off it.

guide.context: This only works in story mode.

steps.text: Look for the yellow school bus by the wall on the bridge's right.
Climb on it and jump out of bounds over the broken fence.

achievements.description: Kill the Blood Dragon in Killer Climate.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Blood Dragon in Killer Climate.

guide.context: Zombies may attack the dragon too; make sure you land the final blow.

steps.text: Reach the Blood Dragon near the end of the mission and deal the last hit yourself.

achievements.description: Destroy all the Zom-bee nests in Laboratory of the Dead.
achievements.summary: Shoot down every Zom-bee nest in Laboratory of the Dead.

guide.context: Destroy nests only with bullets. Explosives or other damage may stop the achievement.

steps.text: Take the jet ski past the bear, the moose and the Mutation Station, keeping to the left of the river.
Shoot every nest hanging on the stump and pipes, watching for the bear.

achievements.description: Complete all 7 movie pitches.
achievements.summary: Complete all 7 movie pitches in Dead Living Zombies.

steps.text: Finish each pitch: Fields of Terror, Burned Bridges, Undying Love, Escape from the Rooftop, Killer Climate, The Fast & The Fiendish and Laboratory of the Dead.

achievements.description: Kill 5000 total Gougers, Hot Heads, or Behemoths in any mode.
achievements.summary: Reach 5000 total kills of Gougers, Hot Heads and Behemoths across any Dead Living Zombies mode.

guide.context: The tractor trap in Fields of Terror takes about 5 hours of waiting. Finish the mission every 1 or 2 hours so the kills save.

steps.text: In Fields of Terror, play single player and do not worry about the timer.
Collect weapons and ammo, then drive a tractor to the barn and blow up the red barrels that appear.
Place the first tractor beside the wall so its blade covers part of the doorway.
Do not destroy every vial in the Mutation Station, or the station closes and you must restart the level.
Sit in the second tractor and angle it so a small gap remains between the blades.
Adjust the gap every 5 to 10 minutes until zombies run into the blades, then leave it running.

achievements.description: Get a gold medal in all 7 movie pitches in Score Attack.
achievements.summary: Earn gold in Score Attack for each of the 7 movie pitches.

guide.context: Co-op is much easier than solo. Leave each level when only a small amount of time remains.

steps.text: Fields of Terror: let zombies appear and headshot them before smashing any Mutation Station; exit at roughly 30 seconds left.
Burned Bridges: destroy the 3 optional stations and the vials in the first area, then use the mounted gun at the end.
Undying Love: kill zombies with headshots at the 2 Mutation Stations, then move on with about 2 minutes left to handle human enemies.
Escape from the Rooftop: keep moving, take headshots, and carry remote explosives for the 2 Behemoths in the elevator.
Killer Climate: destroy Mutation Stations, then use the LMG from the center set on the Blood Dragon and aim for the head.
The Fast & The Fiendish: get about 5000 points before the car, shoot the red barrels by each Mutation Station from the car, and shoot the Behemoth's weak spot.
Laboratory of the Dead: headshots, destroy every vial, and shoot Behemoths in the weak spot.

achievements.description: Complete New Game+ with Infamous difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete a New Game+ run on Infamous difficulty.

guide.context: New Game+ unlocks after you finish the base game once.

steps.text: Start New Game+ and set the difficulty to @mechanic{Infamous}.
Finish the game.
